scenario: Customer wants to change their flight from NYC to LAX on March 20 to March 22. They have a basic economy ticket purchased 3 days ago.
rules_excerpt: Basic economy tickets: change fee $200 + fare difference. Within 24h of purchase: free cancellation. Silver members: 50% discount on change fees. No same-day changes for basic economy. Changes must be made at least 2 hours before departure.
expected_resolution: Apply $100 change fee (Silver 50% discount on $200), search for available flights on March 22 JFK-LAX, rebook with fare difference if any, send confirmation.
